shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' -g '"'!*.lock'"' | sed -n '1,240p' && printf '\\n--- agent instructions ---\\n' && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---' && cat package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/layout.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/page.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/ProductGrid.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,300p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- detail ---' && sed -n '1,300p' 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && printf '%s\\n' '--- skeleton ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- css ---' && sed -n '1,400p' app/globals.css && printf '%s\\n' '--- products ---' && sed -n '1,280p' lib/products.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- config ---' && cat next.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- React view transition exports ---' && rg -n \"ViewTransition|viewTransition\" node_modules/react node_modules/@types/react node_modules/next/dist/client node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,240p' && printf '%s\\n' '--- Next experimental config typing ---' && rg -n \"viewTransition\" node_modules/next -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.ts' | sed -n '1,160p' && printf '%s\\n' '--- git status ---' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '145,195p' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts && sed -n '32,120p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts && node -e \"const r=require('react'); console.log({version:r.version, ViewTransition:typeof r.ViewTransition, unstable_ViewTransition:typeof r.unstable_ViewTransition})\" && git diff -- package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "node - <<'NODE'
const r=require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react'); console.log({version:r.version, ViewTransition:typeof r.ViewTransition, addTransitionType:typeof r.addTransitionType})
NODE
rg -n '\"react\"' node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n--- diff stat ---\\n' && git diff --stat && printf '\\n--- relevant diff ---\\n' && git diff -- app next.config.ts tsconfig.json | sed -n '1,360p' && printf '\\n--- line refs ---\\n' && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,100p' && nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx | sed -n '1,120p' && nl -ba 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' | sed -n '1,180p' && nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '1,320p' && nl -ba next.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- tsconfig.json && cat next-env.d.ts && git diff --check && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore && git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next && git status --short && git diff --check'
/bin/bash -lc 'rm -f next-env.d.ts && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --name-only -- app next.config.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,40p'; nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx | sed -n '1,60p'; nl -ba 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' | sed -n '35,100p'; nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '125,230p'; nl -ba app/react-canary.d.ts; nl -ba next.config.ts"
